exposure: Mediterranean Diet (MedDiet) supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil (EVOO) and pistachios
cohort: 1066 eligible normoglycaemic women before 12 gestational weeks; 932 of whom completed the intervention and follow-up.
finding: An early MedDiet nutritional intervention reduces GDM incidence and maternal-foetal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Caesarean-section rates were reported as an outcome, but no findings specific to mode of delivery were mentioned.
